messages:
alana: Aurora logistics just flagged RMA batch BR-42 at AMS air gateway — container on hold pending insurance valuation docs. vendor_aurora: correct, customs flagged discrepancy between declared value and insurer form. need insured value scanned copy.

mike_ops: how long is hold likely? we have critical H100 replacements queued.
vendor_aurora: typical clearance 48-72h after docs, but with GW surcharges could be longer if insurer needs to reissue.

jonah_procurement: who is covering any extra air surcharges if insurer re-issues? Procurement flagged these as vendor responsibility per SLA for DOA replacements.
vendor_aurora: we can absorb standard handling fees up to $450 per AWB. any insurer reissue fees or freight re-rate beyond that we need to discuss — is Redwood accepting split cost?

alana: SLA clause 7.2 says vendor bears freight & customs costs for DOA replacements in EU, but we can escalate if carrier claims different. copying clause: `vendor liable for freight on DOA within 30 days`.
lisa_logistics: ops note — depot acceptance window is Tue-Thu; if this goes past Thu we'll incur depot overtime and staging fees. expected incremental = ~€1,200/day.

jonah_procurement: vendor_aurora can you confirm you'll cover depot overtime and any AWB reissue fees for BR-42? otherwise we need loaners or partial top-off.
vendor_aurora: we can cover AWB reissue and depot overtime up to €1,000. for amounts beyond that we need written approval.

mike_ops: not ideal. if we can't get full cover, request loaner pool (10 units) shipped ground from DE hub to cover throughput for two weeks. can you book?
vendor_aurora: loaners available but lead time 5 business days and separate manifest/insurance.

alana: ok, immediate ask — vendor please upload insurer confirmation and corrected commercial invoice in this thread. include scanned form with declared value matching invoice and policy number.
vendor_aurora: uploading AWB + insurer ref now: `AWB: NL-803-5543216`, `POLICY: AX-99733-EU`. sending PDF to your SFTP.

rma_bot: RMA BR-42 status changed: HOLD -> AWAITING_DOCUMENTS (1769991150).

lisa_logistics: once docs arrive, can ops coordinate priority clearance? give me ETA on handoff to depot.
mike_ops: if we get docs within 6h, I can greenlight same-day handoff to depot and waive overtime. otherwise prepare for weekend staging.

vendor_aurora: insurer says electronic endorsement issued. I'll share confirmation link and the adjusted invoice within 30 minutes.

jonah_procurement: also, vendor — because this batch hit an AMS hold, can you confirm we get allocation credit for 12 units (BR-42) against next month's committed pool? we need to reconcile billing.
vendor_aurora: yes, we'll issue a credit memo for the 12 units pending final closure. recon team will send draft by EOD.

alana: thanks. action items: vendor upload insurer docs + adjusted invoice (vendor_aurora), ops on standby for same-day handoff if docs in 6h (mike_ops, lisa_logistics), procurement to expect credit memo draft (jonah_procurement).

mike_ops: quick note — snapshot of problematic serials for audit: `S/N: H100-FF-00021` `H100-FF-00022` `H100-FF-00023`. attach photos when handing off.

vendor_aurora: uploaded insurer endorsement and updated commercial invoice to SFTP. please confirm retrieval.
alana: I pulled the files, values match. marking AWAITING_CLEARANCE. thanks :thumbsup:

rma_bot: RMA BR-42 status changed: AWAITING_CLEARANCE -> RELEASED_TO_CUSTOMS (1769991288).

lisa_logistics: got release. I'll schedule pickup for 16:00 CET and ETA depot 18:30 CET.
mike_ops: will meet at depot for recieve + QA. good job team.
